name: Atlas Switch Co., Inc.
old_description: Custom switchboards, panelboards, and electrical distribution equipment; largest WBE manufacturer of its kind in NY
about:
Atlas Switch Co., Inc. is headquartered in Garden City, New York. The company is certified as a Women's Business Enterprise (WBE) and identifies as the largest woman-owned manufacturer of electrical service and distribution equipment in New York.

The company custom manufactures panel boards and switchboards to meet project-specific requirements and building space constraints. Its product line includes panel boards with integral metering and integral surge protective devices (SPD), as well as switchboards. Atlas Switch also supplies transformers, disconnect switches, busway, and metering solutions through partnerships with other manufacturers.

Atlas Switch serves residential, commercial, and industrial construction projects across New York State, with extended reach into New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts via partners. Its client roster includes the NYC Port Authority, Mount Sinai Health System, New York University, Northwell Health, JP Morgan Chase, Citibank, Google, Amazon, Facebook, and Bloomberg. The company has contributed to major developments such as World Trade Center Tower 4, Yankee Stadium, Madison Square Garden, the TWA Hotel at JFK, and the Hudson Yards project.

Atlas Switch emphasizes its status as the largest WBE manufacturer of its kind in New York and its ability to deliver custom electrical distribution equipment tailored to unique space constraints. The firm was founded to address the need for specialized, project-specific switchgear in the dense New York City building environment.

name: Atv Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Tie Rods CJ Applications will fit Saginaw and Ford Reverse Steering Kits
about:
ATV Manufacturing Inc., doing business as Herm The Overdrive Guy, operates from Brush Prairie, Washington. The company was founded by Herm, who began modifying his 1960 CJ-5 and turned that hands‑on experience into a small business focused on early Jeep drivetrain components. No founding year is published.

The shop manufactures new overdrives and remanufactures transmissions, transfer cases, gearboxes, and brake system components for Jeep models equipped with Dana 18, Dana 20, and Dana 300 transfer cases, as well as other automotive applications. Services include transmission rebuild kits, transfer‑case rebuilds, overdrive rebuilds, winch rebuilds, power‑take‑off installation, and a range of conversion kits for steering and brakes. Quality control relies on in‑house Rockwell hardness testing and dimensional checks against a library of OEM parts. The company ships orders worldwide.

Customers include Jeep restoration enthusiasts, off‑road clubs, and commercial accounts such as Crown Automotive Sales. The product line spans Dana 25/27, 30, 44, 53, and 60 axle components, differential kits, ring‑and‑pinion sets, emergency‑brake hardware, steering tie‑rods, and winch accessories.

Herm emphasizes personal attention, low prices, and a ‘like‑new’ remanufacturing process that replaces all wear items with new bearings, seals, gaskets, and snap rings. Every unit is fully inspected before shipment, and the owner stands behind all products and services with a direct contact policy.

about:
Auto Customs was founded in 1986 in Honolulu, Hawaii, and operates as a locally-owned and operated business in the Waiakamilo business district. The company began as a single-location shop serving Oahu and the outer islands with automotive parts and installation services.

The company stocks and installs a wide range of aftermarket automotive products, including wheels, factory-replacement performance tires, suspension components, HID/LED lighting, brakes, window tint, exhaust systems, intakes, and body kits. Its 6,000-square-foot facility houses tire-balancing equipment and a team of installers who handle everything from custom wheel fitments to suspension modifications. The shop also maintains a comfortable lounge for customers waiting on service.

Auto Customs serves retail customers across Honolulu, Oahu, and the outer Hawaiian islands, catering to both stock-replacement needs (tire sizes from 13 to 32 inches) and highly modified builds ranging from lowered “hella-flush” cars to lifted four-wheel-drive trucks. The company’s inventory spans OEM and aftermarket brands from AEM to Zinik.

The business emphasizes a one-stop-shop approach, combining product availability with same-day installation capability, and highlights its knowledgeable staff and customer service as key differentiators in the local aftermarket scene.

name: Auto Lift Parts, LLC
old_description: FREE Ground Shipping (carrier of our choice) for all listed products on our website.
about:
Auto Lift Parts, LLC operates from Plano, Illinois, as an owner-operated, family-focused business. The company's owner-operators bring more than 60 years of combined experience in the auto lift parts industry, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm supplies both OEM and aftermarket replacement parts for surface-mount and in-ground automotive lifts. Its catalog spans cables, power units, hydraulic cylinders, seal kits, height extensions, truck adapters, and carriage components. Orders placed by 3 p.m. CST Monday through Friday ship the same day via ground service from multiple nationwide locations, supported by a dedicated staff with deep product knowledge.

Customers include independent repair shops, dealership service departments, and any facility that relies on automotive lifts. The company stocks parts for major brands such as Rotary Lift, BendPak, Dannmar, Eagle, Gemini, Team Lift, Wheeltronic, Snap-on, Ammco, John Bean, Accuturn, Benwil, and Forward Lift, and also assists in identifying obscure or discontinued lift models to locate hard-to-find components.

Auto Lift Parts distinguishes itself by putting owner-operators directly on the phone to provide expert guidance, offering same-day shipping on in-stock items, and leveraging a multi-location fulfillment network to minimize downtime for shops awaiting critical lift repairs.

name: Auto Tech
old_description: With decades of experience under the hood, Auto Tech of Jackson Hole gets you back on the road - fast!
about:
Auto Tech of Jackson Hole operates in Jackson, Wyoming, where it has served the Teton Valley for many years. The shop came under new ownership in recent years when Levi Shervin, a technician with decades of experience in the area, took over the business. Shervin’s background in the valley’s automotive needs shaped the shop’s focus on honest, affordable car care for local drivers.

The facility provides a full range of automotive repair and maintenance services. Technicians handle check-engine-light diagnostics, brake repair, battery testing and replacement, wheel alignment, oil and fluid changes, emissions testing, suspension work, tune-ups, general maintenance, towing, and seasonal winterizing. The shop services all vehicle types and emphasizes getting customers back on the road quickly.

Primary customers are residents and businesses in Teton County who rely on personal and commercial vehicles for daily transportation. The shop’s service list reflects the demands of a mountain climate, with particular attention to winter readiness and safety inspections.

Shervin states that the business was rebuilt around transparent consulting and pricing that won’t leave drivers stranded, and that winter safety remains a top priority for every vehicle that enters the bay.
